name: Chikoubo ~Kegasareta Souden~
source:
The protagonist, “Keiichi Tachibana,” is a boy attending a prestigious high school. The story begins one month after Keiichi’s father dies in an accident.
Following the death of his wealthy father, relatives eager to get their hands on the estate swarmed around Keiichi and his stepmother, “Miyuki Tachibana.”
The timid Miyuki could only flounder in confusion, but to avoid unnecessary conflict, Keiichi advised her to keep only enough of the estate to ensure they could live comfortably for the time being and renounce the rest.

Once the relatives had taken their share of the estate and left, Keiichi was left with only a portion of the fortune and his stepmother, Miyuki.
But that was enough for Keiichi. After his father’s death, the protagonist attacked Miyuki, whom he had long had his eye on, and forced her into a perverse physical relationship.
With all his troubles gone, Keiichi enjoyed his young and beautiful stepmother’s body without having to worry about anyone else. But one day, a visitor came to the house.
The visitor’s name was “Kyoko Okudera,” and she claimed to be the protagonist’s mother. Having given up her son due to unavoidable circumstances, Kyoko approached Miyuki and asked to take Keiichi back.
Though surprised and bewildered by Kyoko’s sudden appearance—especially since she had come to take him back—Keiichi was captivated by her body, which was far too alluring for a mother. He set his sights not only on Miyuki but also on Kyoko, drawing her into his web of seduction.


[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070202065239/http://www.blackpackage.co.jp/products/r9/story.html]the official site, archived[/url]]
